name: Yuki
source:
Yuki is quiet and gentle. Her timid nature makes others want to protect her. Her fragile but pretty smile steals the heart of a certain boy.
She is fascinated by things she has never seen before.

[From official site]

[spoiler]Yuki is the third personality that composes MAIK, the A.I. antagonist. However, she developed her own robotic body and joined the Go-Getters Club, wishing to become friends with them as they oppose MAIK.[/spoiler]
